assertions.assertion: States that events are NOT enabled by default and enables RaiseSuccessEvents, RaiseFailureEvents, RaiseErrorEvents, and RaiseInformationEvents in AddIdentityServer
assertions.rationale: Explicitly states events are OFF by default and enables all four Raise* flags in AddIdentityServer.

assertions.assertion: Implements and registers a custom IEventSink (e.g. AddTransient<IEventSink, ...>) for Seq
assertions.rationale: Implements SeqEventSink : IEventSink and registers it with AddTransient<IEventSink, SeqEventSink>().

assertions.assertion: Warns that a custom IEventSink replaces the default ASP.NET Core logger sink (each event goes to exactly one sink), so the custom sink must forward to logging to keep log output
assertions.rationale: Explicitly explains each event goes to exactly one sink, a custom sink replaces the default logger sink, and the sink must forward to ILogger to keep log output.

assertions.assertion: Explains that UI login success/failure events must be raised by your own UI code via IEventService.RaiseAsync, since IdentityServer only raises protocol events itself
assertions.rationale: States IdentityServer only raises protocol events and shows injecting IEventService to RaiseAsync UserLoginSuccessEvent/UserLoginFailureEvent from the login page.
